nodes.name: read-pdf.mjs
nodes.summary: Short utility script for reading PDF files, likely used during research or data-ingestion workflows as a one-off helper.

nodes.name: read-wiki-pages.mjs
nodes.summary: Script for fetching and reading wiki pages, used to extract knowledge content for seeding or evaluation datasets.

nodes.name: run-mini-locomo.ts
nodes.summary: CLI orchestrator for running mini LoCoMo benchmark cells with configurable concurrency, model aliases, and field-coverage verification; spawns child processes per benchmark cell and aggregates JSONL results.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses spawned child processes per cell to enable concurrency isolation; parses a YAML manifest for benchmark configuration rather than hardcoding parameters.

nodes.name: parseArgs
nodes.summary: Parses CLI arguments for the mini LoCoMo runner, extracting cells, model aliases, concurrency, and manifest path.

nodes.name: runOneCell
nodes.summary: Executes a single LoCoMo benchmark cell by spawning a child process, streaming stdout/stderr, and capturing the JSONL result file path.

nodes.name: runCellsWithConcurrency
nodes.summary: Runs multiple benchmark cells with bounded concurrency using batched Promise.all execution.

nodes.name: rewriteJsonlCellField
nodes.summary: Rewrites a specific field in a JSONL output file to map v3 cell names to v1 cell names for compatibility.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point that orchestrates the full mini LoCoMo benchmark run: validates aliases, maps cells, spawns concurrent runners, and produces field-coverage reports.

nodes.name: run-pilot-2026-04-26.ts
nodes.summary: Full-featured pilot benchmark runner for LoCoMo evaluation, implementing multi-step retrieval agents, trio judge scoring (Opus/GPT/Minimax), JSONL result writing, and cumulative cost tracking across benchmark cells.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses both a solo agent path and a multi-step retrieval loop with Ollama/HiveMind substrate integration; trio-judge consensus scoring uses arithmetic mean across three LLM judges.

nodes.name: llmCall
nodes.summary: Makes a retry-capable LLM API call via LiteLLM or direct provider endpoints with exponential backoff on failure.

nodes.name: judgeWithTrio
nodes.summary: Runs three judge LLMs in parallel and computes aggregate trio-mean, min, and max scores for a benchmark response.

nodes.name: writeSummary
nodes.summary: Writes a JSON summary of benchmark results including per-category scores, cumulative cost, and timing to disk.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Main orchestrator for the pilot benchmark run, handling argument parsing, cell iteration, multi-step retrieval, judgment, result persistence, and cost aggregation.

nodes.name: scan-locomo-deep.mjs
nodes.summary: Utility script that deep-scans LoCoMo dataset conversations, collecting turn sequences for data exploration and analysis.

nodes.name: scan-locomo-for-triples.mjs
nodes.summary: Scans LoCoMo conversation turns for knowledge triples using regex pattern matching, outputting formatted hits for dataset analysis.

nodes.name: seed-real-data.mjs
nodes.summary: Seeds the HiveMind knowledge graph with real development project entities, memory frames, and relations for integration testing and demo scenarios.
nodes.languageNotes: Directly calls into the HiveMind KnowledgeGraph API to create entities and relations, bypassing the HTTP API.

nodes.name: smoke-qwen-dual-route.mjs
nodes.summary: Smoke test that probes dual Qwen model routes through LiteLLM, verifying both aliases respond correctly and checking response consistency.

nodes.name: smoke-sonnet-route.mjs
nodes.summary: Smoke test script that verifies the Claude Sonnet LiteLLM route is reachable and returns a valid completion, with detailed error classification.

nodes.name: sprint-11-b1-smoke.mjs
nodes.summary: Sprint 11 batch-1 smoke test for the LiteLLM chat endpoint, testing reasoning model response parsing and artifact persistence.

nodes.name: sprint-11-b2-grok-smoke.mjs
nodes.summary: Sprint 11 batch-2 smoke test targeting the Grok model via LiteLLM, parsing judge-format JSON responses and saving structured artifacts.

nodes.name: stage-0-query.mjs
nodes.summary: Benchmark stage-0 query script that recalls memory context via the HiveMind CLI, constructs enriched prompts, and calls either LiteLLM or Ollama backends to produce and persist LLM answers with cost tracking.

nodes.name: test-full-compile.mjs
nodes.summary: Script that verifies the full monorepo TypeScript compilation succeeds by running tsc across all packages.

nodes.name: test-synthesizer.mjs
nodes.summary: Minimal script for testing the memory synthesizer pipeline, likely used for ad-hoc verification of the cognify/synthesis flow.

nodes.name: vendor-availability-probe.mjs
nodes.summary: Probes multiple LLM vendor endpoints (Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.) through LiteLLM to verify availability, classifying responses as success, auth-error, quota-error, or model-not-found.

nodes.name: vision-judge-workflow.mjs
nodes.summary: Defines a vision-judge agent workflow that fans out one vision judge per screenshot and reduces results using an objective floor, used for visual regression evaluation.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package configuration for the standalone sidecar directory, defining its name, entry point, scripts and local dependencies separate from the main workspace.

nodes.name: skill-loader.ts
nodes.summary: Provides the SkillLoader class that discovers skill definitions from configured directories by parsing YAML frontmatter and deduplicating by skill name.

nodes.name: SkillLoader
nodes.summary: Scans one or more directories for skill markdown files, parses their YAML frontmatter, and returns a deduplicated list of available skills.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the sidecar directory, specifying included source paths and excluded directories.

nodes.name: agent-behavior-audit.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive integration audit script that runs 10 sequential agent sessions to validate memory formation, recall, entity extraction, persona switching, evolution pipeline, cross-workspace isolation, and edge-case robustness.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses raw HTTP requests rather than a test framework, making it runnable standalone as an audit tool; inspects SQLite memory databases directly via better-sqlite3.

nodes.name: chat
nodes.summary: Sends a chat message to the agent server via HTTP and collects SSE events and the final text response.

nodes.name: inspectMind
nodes.summary: Opens a workspace SQLite memory database directly and returns frame counts, entity counts, and entity lists for audit assertions.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Orchestrates all 10 audit sessions sequentially, aggregates pass/fail counts, writes a JSON result file, and exits with a non-zero code on failure.

nodes.name: dock-app-title-consistency.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit test that verifies dock app label consistency across the codebase, ensuring app IDs are mapped to the same display labels in all UI surfaces.

nodes.name: docker-compose-litellm-env.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest test that validates all environment variable references in litellm-config.yaml are also declared in docker-compose files, preventing misconfigured deployments.

nodes.name: boot-screen-skip.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright E2E spec testing the boot screen skip flow, verifying that the onboarding wizard is shown on first launch and can be bypassed via localStorage flag.

nodes.name: competitive-benchmarks.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright E2E benchmark spec with 1000+ lines validating memory storage, retrieval accuracy, temporal reasoning, open-ended questions, and multi-hop recall against competitive baselines.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Playwright's APIRequestContext for direct HTTP memory API calls rather than browser UI interactions, making it a hybrid API+benchmark test.

nodes.name: network-drop.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright E2E failure-injection spec that tests application resilience during network drops, verifying graceful degradation and reconnection behavior.
